name: catch fish

text: Two fish are taken from the pool, and lie struggling in the grass.
The same quiet reach of river yields two useful fish.
You secure two silver fish, a satisfactory return for your patience.
One fish rewards your labour in the river.
You draw one struggling fish out of the water.
Your spear takes a single fish, surprisingly heavy for its size.
The current carries the disturbed fish beyond your reach.
At the first movement the fish vanish into deeper water.
The spear rises bearing nothing but a strand of river weed.

log: You take your position on a stone above the pool and wait with spear raised.
You wade knee-deep into the current, seeking a fish that holds still.
In the shade of the willows, you wait for the proper moment to strike.
